finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: An attacker can provide a filename that includes shell metacharacters or commands.
finding.assumptions: The program does not sanitize or validate the filename input before using it to open a file.

finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: An attacker can provide a candidate or party name that includes shell metacharacters or commands.
finding.assumptions: The program does not sanitize or validate the candidate or party names before using them.

finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: An attacker can provide a vote that includes shell metacharacters or commands.
finding.assumptions: The program does not sanitize or validate the vote input before using it.

finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: An attacker can control the winner variable, which could include shell metacharacters or commands.
finding.assumptions: The program does not sanitize or validate the winner variable before using it in the output.
